name: Bienoise
description: FAILURE AS GOAL brings together Bienoise's laptop compositions and his collection of non-musical finds to create a context for listening. Minimalist, contemplative yet disruptive electronic music built upon emergent behaviors of tools is presented in an always-changing and necessarily site-specific live performance, exploiting duration and context as devices to materialize the contemporary illusion of transparent media and the meaningfulness of what is not yet signal: glitches, digital low-fidelity, extreme data compression and algorithmic artifacts are reappropriated and become audible and thematic. Music neither for the body nor for the mind, but soundtracks for empty stages.
bio: Alberto Ricca is Bienoise. His laptop compositions show affection for humble non-musical elements, and for the music they hide. His MOST BEAUTIFUL DESIGN EP, a collection of low-bitrate mp3s, has been released on floppy disk in 2018 by Mille Plateaux, followed by the 2022 album THIS MEANING TODAY. In the same year, he published for NERO and NON 'L'arte dell'Algoritmo: La Morte \ Apathetic Algorithms, Artificial Artisans', a reflection on boredom and generative media; he also wrote 'The Mbira The Hammer Betrayal' for Achim Szepanski's Ultrablack of Music II. He authored the music for the contemporary dance performances TO BE BANNED FROM ROME (2017, with Annamaria Ajmone), SPEEED (2020) and HIT (2024), with Parini Secondo, and DANSE MACABRE! (2023), HERE AND NOW and MANIFESTUS (2025), with Jacopo Jenna. Since 2019, Radio Raheem Milan has hosted his selections of involuntary compositions in the monthly show NON MUSICA. He’s a teacher. He’s not a DJ.
